quotes.text: We determine Smart Disputes eligibility using multiple factors, including the dispute reason code, payment method, evidence availability, evidence relevance, and cost.
If you don’t take any action, Smart Disputes automatically submits the pre-filled evidence packet just before the dispute times out.

We don’t guarantee that disputes countered with Smart disputes will be resolved in your favor, because the final decision lies with the issuer. However, we only bill you a Smart Disputes fee if you win.
To test responses to Smart Disputes eligible disputes, use the following test card, which creates a Smart Disputes eligible dispute:

findings: The November capture of the same URL retains the existing Smart Disputes mechanism, eligibility factors, merchant override, evidence-data responsibility, issuer decision, and win-only Smart Disputes fee (new raw:13,27,30,32; old raw:12,27,30,32). The current source accurately summarizes these at lines 13-36.

A new Testing section at new raw:38-46 provides a specific test card 4000000001000043, PaymentMethod pm_card_createAutoRepresentmentEligibleDispute, and token tok_createAutoRepresentmentEligibleDispute for creating a Smart Disputes eligible test dispute. This is a substantive, discoverable testing capability absent from the old raw and current source; add a concise Testing locator and the new raw citation to the existing source summary.

The old capture ends abruptly at '## Request access' (old raw:38), whereas the new capture presents Testing. The old heading has no body or access terms, and its omission cannot prove Smart Disputes is generally available, request access is no longer needed, or account eligibility changed.

Other diff changes are heading whitespace, image asset URLs, and spacing. No general production outcome, issuer win guarantee, or current merchant entitlement follows from the testing examples. The disputes concept already routes Smart Disputes at lines 157 and 161; its durable description need not change.
substantive_changes: The new same-URL capture adds test identifiers and a statement that the indicated test card creates a Smart Disputes eligible dispute (new raw:38-46).
historical_claims_to_preserve: The May capture's final 'Request access' heading at old raw:38 is historical captured text without explanatory content; preserve the old raw and make no availability inference from its absence in November.

Eligible card disputes receive automated evidence compilation and submission just before the deadline if the merchant takes no action; the merchant may counter or accept before deadline, and can disable auto-submit (old raw:27; new raw:27).
The issuer decides the outcome, and Stripe charges the Smart Disputes fee only for wins (old raw:32; new raw:32).
unresolved_questions: The same-URL captures do not establish any change in production access or account eligibility. The old 'Request access' section has only a heading, and the November Testing section does not address rollout status.
